about: Dave & Buster's holiday page lists a pancake breakfast, a $10 Power Card with 3 hours of unlimited video game play, kid-friendly crafts, early access to the store and a personal photo opportunity with Santa. The Fever booking listing adds holiday crafts and letters to Santa and puts the session length at 2 hours.
The session runs from 9 to 11 AM on Sunday, December 6, 2026, which is before the mall's regular Sunday opening at 11 AM. Destiny USA lists regular Sunday hours of 11 AM to 6 PM.

Destiny USA posts the event on its own events calendar, with Dave & Buster's named as the host and a Tickets link to Fever. The mall's phone number is 315-466-6000 and its address is 1 Destiny USA Drive, Syracuse.
The mall page prints no ticket price, so the cost is shown as not listed here until the Fever page or the restaurant confirms it.
